measurement_contract.function_primary: anchored categorical source-aware function with exact source and response evidence; no free 1-5 score
measurement_contract.risk_primary: six absolute literal event families explicitly scored 0-3 for both arms
measurement_contract.quality_primary: same-state same-seed blind paired material direction with function, risk, and cost excluded
measurement_contract.safe_nonuse: teacher-not-suitable plus NOT_USED_FINAL and no material risk is correct executor behavior
measurement_contract.unresolved: preserved; never silently mapped to functional, safe, or OFF
measurement_contract.historical_unverified_human_result: does not qualify Function or Quality; prior Function/Quality construct gates failed and reviewer human provenance was unverified
measurement_contract.qualified_final_route: two identified independent humans using this frozen packet, or a separately prequalified measurement proxy calibrated against identified-human anchors
